title: Storage / objects
description: Buckets, objects, metadata and usage for the active workspace. Create buckets, upload objects and delete a bucket (with confirmation) from this page.
bucketsDescription: Visible inventory for the active workspace.
noBuckets: There are no buckets in the selected workspace.
noBucketsDescription: Create your first bucket to start storing objects.
bucketHelp: The name is a hint: the final name may be normalized (lowercase, DNS-safe) and scoped to this workspace. The actual name is confirmed after creation.
name: Name
usageDescription: Public snapshot of volume, counts and distribution by bucket.
noQuota: The public API does not expose a quota limit for this snapshot.
providerUnavailable: The provider has no available usage snapshot right now. The console does not interpret this as zero.

noBreakdown: There is no per-bucket breakdown in the public snapshot.
selectBucket: Select a bucket to inspect objects, metadata and supporting surfaces available in the public API.
uploadKeyHelp: Leave blank to use the file name.
uploadFileHelp: Uploaded as base64 to preserve the original bytes.
noObjectsDescription: Upload the first object to start using it.
metadataDescription: Read-only details from the public metadata endpoint.
noCustomMetadata: This object exposes no custom metadata.
presignDescription: Generate a temporary, scoped URL to download an object without Falcone credentials. It is limited to this bucket, key and download operation; the TTL is clamped to the platform maximum.
selectObject: Select an object in the Objects tab to generate its download URL.
unsupported: Multipart uploads are not available in the current public API.
unsupportedDescription: The public storage API has no inventory GET route for this surface. The console stays read-only and does not use undocumented routes.
deleteImpact: The bucket and ALL its objects will be permanently deleted. This action is irreversible.
typedName: Type the exact bucket name to confirm.
outcomeUnknown: The bucket creation outcome is unknown. The inventory was refreshed; creation was not resent.
workspaceDescription: Select a workspace to view storage resources.
